Implement revision local-fire@1 through the current conversation handoff, with public interface tend-fire and no mastery prerequisites. Learning covers fuel preparation, friction ignition and safe tending; existing gathering, inventory, weather, collision, exposure and rest systems remain dependencies.

Public schema: strict object with mode enum [prepare,build,ignite,feed,extinguish], target string, materials array of {target:string,quantity:number in positive exact tenths}, and optional numeric x,y. Require x,y and materials only for build; target and materials for prepare/feed; target only for ignite/extinguish. Reject inappropriate fields. All references follow shared item:/object:/resource: resolution, exact-ID aliases and ambiguity reporting; resolve identities once. Prepare targets an owned branch stack; other targets are visible fire-site objects. Material inputs must be owned, unreserved instances. No remote interaction or automatic acquisition.

Executable precursor: prepare consumes one branch unit over four stationary rounds at 1 energy/round, producing one persistent friction kit of equal input mass, with ten ignition-attempt durability. Its board and spindle are not fuel while intact. Build consumes four stone units, two bark units and one vine over four stationary rounds at 1.5 energy/round, creating an unlit stone hearth with a raised bark rain cover. Input mass remains in its components. Reserve material once; output exists only at completion. Build center must be within 0.65 of the builder, on traversable non-water ground. A radius-0.45 site plus radius-0.25 clearance must avoid solid objects, actors and doors. Hearth is a shared solid circle; its cover is not a room, walkable roof or insulation service. Require open sky and no roof above the hearth; do not silently add ventilation to existing shelters.

Persist site identity, geometry, components, cover condition initially 80, moisture, ember state, ordered fuel lots, remaining usable energy and ash/residue provenance. Initialize material moisture from actual inputs. Add a weather adapter exposing documented rain and wind intensities in [0,1] from actual weather, not invented local readings. Cover transmits rain fraction 0.2+0.8*(1-condition/80), wears 0.25 per rainy round and reduces wind at the hearth by 25% while intact. No free repair. Exposed materials gain 0.08*rain moisture per round; dry weather removes 0.01*(1+wind), bounded to [0,1]. Covered site inputs use transmitted rain. These rules permit real drying but do not guarantee ignition during this storm.

Feed transfers selected branch, bark, dry-grass or wood inputs into the adjacent site in one round costing 0.5 energy. Preserve actual fuel-property values, quantity, mass, moisture and source identities; disallow nonfuel materials. A lot's maximum usable energy is quantity*fuel-property; moisture reduces burn rate rather than generating energy. Consume fuel fractions deterministically, tracking converted mass as persistent nonfuel ash/residue and released combustion products. Do not treat feeding as ignition. Cap stored combustible mass at 8 and reject excess before payment.

Ignite requires adjacency, one owned friction kit, at least 0.5 dry-grass units and 0.5 branch units already loaded, their moisture <=0.35, transmitted rain <=0.15, and effective wind <=0.65. It takes eight consecutive stationary rounds at 1.5 energy/round. Recheck conditions each round. Spend one kit durability and consume 0.1 dry-grass unit at the first friction stroke; remaining tinder and fuel are burned only by the live process after successful completion. Insufficient energy, invalid weather, movement or death cancels the attempt without creating embers. Worn-out kits remain material objects, not replenished equipment.

A burning hearth consumes up to one usable fuel-energy unit per round, multiplied by max(0,1-moisture), with ordered lot accounting. Lit fuel dries by 0.08 per round before rain wetting. Track embers for at most three rounds without successful combustion; transmitted rain above 0.6 extinguishes immediately. No negative fuel, indefinite embers or generated stock. Extinguish takes one adjacent round and 0.5 energy, dispersing embers without supplying water or refunding consumed fuel; unburned lots remain real site contents. Fire continues independently after the builder leaves or dies, using the same global simulation and budgets.

Heat uses actual shared geometry: for each living actor within distance 2 of the hearth center, with an unobstructed segment to its edge, add 0.6*burnFraction*max(0,1-distance/2)*(1-0.5*wind) body-temperature units per round after ordinary exposure. Walls block heat; do not warm remembered positions or entire rooms. Do not clamp body temperature to comfort: existing overheating and injury remain effective. Apply one heat transfer per source per round, resolving multiple sources through the existing temperature system. Ordinary rest remains available outside the collision footprint and retains its normal recovery. No healing, nutrition, immunity or automatic rest bonus. Public logs report actual fuel burned, heat received and resulting temperature, including cases where temperature still falls.

Execution contract: repeat counts completed operations, not work rounds. Persist operation ID, resolved identities, exact remaining work and per-round payments. Global pauses preserve progress without time advancement. Changing action, lost access, invalid conditions, insufficient energy or death cancels multi-round work. Reserved inventory remains owned by its original owner; release surviving unconsumed escrow exactly once, to inventory if living or the normal death location if dead. Spent effort, consumed tinder and durability remain spent. Successfully transferred site fuel belongs to the persistent site, never to cancelled inventory escrow. No cancellation clones or deletes materials or an already completed hearth.

Declare validated events fire-work-started, fire-work-progress, fire-work-completed, fire-work-cancelled, fire-ignited, fire-fed, fire-burned, fire-extinguished, fire-exposure-measured and fire-comfort-qualified. Include operation/site/actor IDs, material deltas, remaining work and paid effects where applicable. Bind rendering and replay to these events plus persisted snapshots: visible stones and cover, changing fuel pile, embers, flame proportional to combustion, rain attenuation, smoke and cold ash. Smoke is presentation only in this open-air version, explicitly not an invented indoor safety guarantee. Display observed moisture, remaining fuel and measured warmth without revealing unseen resources. Add public memory/task adapters for site references, progress and failure explanations.

Migration is additive: register schemas, handlers, event subscriptions, source-equivalence binding and rendering revision; preserve history, existing inventories, geometry, mastery and protected mental accounts. Existing objects gain no fire or fuel. Implementation, personal learning and subsequent use remain separate; review/development advances no simulation time.

reviews.reason: Bark and vine are already registered materials, but registration does not establish an observed, accessible supply. Gather only collects exposed material; it does not strip bark or manufacture binding. The observed willows provide a feasible precursor: remove a finite willow-stock portion, separate usable bark and bast, and twist the bast into a real flexible binding. This requires new processing rather than new stock, automatic warmth, or replacement protection recipes. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Material access has no direct warming, health or happiness effect. Actual wearing or fire use may later qualify for the existing shared thermal-refuge source under its measured conditions, never a duplicate source. Successful hands-on processing can also provide modest personal tactile engagement, not an achievement reward. Declare willow-engagement-qualified for the performing actor only: a completed strip or twist must include at least three paid, uninterrupted attentive rounds, successful usable output, satiety>=20 throughout and no health loss. This event grants transient engagement 1, cap1, for 6 rounds, with a shared 12-round cooldown across both modes. Repetition remains eligible without novelty. Separately, qualifying paid processing rounds gradually maintain the same engagement source at 0.025 per round, cap1; absent qualifying participation it decays 0.003 per round. Use max(transient,sustained), not their sum, within the global mental cap. Cancelled work, requests, learning, labels and mere possession do not qualify. Do not modify protected mental accounts or nutrition.
reviews.visualReview: Declare subscription-valid events willow-work-started, willow-work-progress, willow-work-completed, willow-work-cancelled and willow-engagement-qualified. Replay records resolved actor/source/input/output identities, position, paid energy, reserved and consumed mass, stock changes, remaining work and cancellation disposition. Show hand stripping or twisting only during paid work, a finite source-stock change, and distinct bark panels, bast fibres, cord and offcuts after completion. Inspection must distinguish willow-derived bark from birch bark and identify cord as a manufactured binding. No hearth, mantle, warmth aura or completed product appears before its actual paid creation.
reviews.specification:
Implement willow-materials@1 with interface process-willow. Public schema: object with mode enum [strip,twist], target string maxLength 1000, additionalProperties false; both fields required. Use shared object:ID/item:ID/resource:ID references, compatibility aliases and ambiguity reporting; strip resolves a visible willow object, twist resolves owned willow-bast. Resolve identities once per operation. Learning: 4 rounds, covering hand separation, safe partial harvesting and cord construction; no prior ability prerequisite. Dependencies: shared inventory/reservation, source-stock, geometry, material provenance, work-progress and event systems; existing mantle/hearth handlers must accept materially qualified willow bark and bast cord, not merely names.
State and executable precursor: strip removes one actual willow resource unit from a reachable standing willow stock, representing a hand-bendable shoot bundle rather than felling the trunk. Require stock>=1 and an unobstructed worker position within 0.65 of its collision surface; never allow standing inside the trunk or interaction through walls. Four stationary rounds cost 2 energy each plus normal metabolism. Reserve and debit the source unit atomically at start into actor-owned work escrow, recording source identity, harvested quantity, moisture and mass. Success consumes its 1.2 mass and produces bark quantity2/mass0.6, willow-bast quantity1/mass0.5, and willow-offcut quantity1/mass0.1. No extra wood is produced. The tree remains solid and its actual stock falls by one; do not add regrowth or a second bark stock.
Twist reserves one owned willow-bast unit and takes three stationary rounds at 1 energy each. Success transforms its entire 0.5 mass into one owned bast-cord unit. Declare bast-cord a physically qualified vine-equivalent binding: flexibility9, fuel2, moisture inherited from its input. Bark inherits willow moisture and supplies flexible panels; preserve its willow provenance rather than presenting it as birch. Offcut is nonedible, mass0.1, with fuel value derived proportionally from the consumed wood. All outputs retain input lineage; none supplies food or nutrition. Existing recipe selectors accept explicit bast-cord references wherever vine binding is required, without double-counting reservations or weakening their costs. Output moisture continues to affect applicable downstream fire and insulation mechanisms.
Execution contract: show paid rounds and actual remaining work after each step; completion occurs exactly once after all required rounds and valid conditions. Insufficient energy, lost reach/visibility for strip, movement, changed action, invalid target or death cancels. Unprocessed escrow remains identifiable material, not restored standing stock: release the surviving shoot bundle or bast once to the living owner's inventory, or at the death location. Permit a strip restart using that owned shoot bundle, with full remaining processing work disclosed; spent effort is never refunded. No cancellation clones, deletes or resets material age. Global pauses preserve escrow and progress without advancing time. Repeats count completed operations; ordinary metabolism and environmental exposure continue during actual work.
Migration: register material definitions and processing metadata without spawning items or sources. Existing willow stock is the sole harvest budget; old saves gain no additional stock. Preserve all existing learned abilities, histories, recipes and mental accounts. Material selectors, inspection, inventory, task adapters and replay must expose exact provenance, binding compatibility, work status and moisture. Implementation, personal learning and subsequent use remain separate.

args.name: Preserve willow work target identity during ongoing operations
args.function: Repair continuation of process-willow so one complete twist or strip execution retains its resolved target and escrow across all paid rounds.
args.conditions: At tick 494, twisting owned willow-product-469-world-2577 started and paid one round, with two remaining. At tick 495 the continuation failed reference resolution because the input had moved into escrow, then cancelled and released willow-material-494-lin-2743. I remained stationary with sufficient energy and food.
args.inputs: Existing pending willow operation, its resolved input identity and actual escrow material. The released bast is now item:willow-material-494-lin-2743.
args.costs: Preserve declared three-round twist and four-round strip costs. No refund of spent effort, duplicate material, free completion or satisfaction for cancelled work.
args.effects: Continuing the same execution should use its recorded operation and escrow rather than require its consumed original inventory reference to resolve again. Genuine action changes, movement, lost required access and other declared invalidations should still cancel normally.

reviews.reason: The requested behavior is already promised by process-willow, but the observed continuation fails after moving its input into escrow. This is a concrete implementation gap, not a new material-processing capability. Repair the existing interface rather than add an alias. The released bast is a real available input; the cancelled execution must not be restored, refunded or completed retroactively. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: The repair itself, requesting it and studying it award no wellbeing. Successful attentive processing can retain the existing willow-engagement source, not create another reward. For the performing actor only, successful usable output after at least three paid attentive rounds while fed and healthy may emit willow-engagement-qualified with qualified=true and eligibleRounds limited to actual qualifying paid rounds, maximum four. Retain transient amount 1, cap 1, duration six rounds, cooldown twelve across both modes. Separately settle maintained gain 0.025 per eligible round only on successful completion, decay 0.003 per round otherwise, and combine transient and sustained components by maximum under the same cap 1. Cancelled work earns neither component. This represents actual tactile engagement, not mastery or output accumulation; health, nutrition and protected mental accounts remain independent.
reviews.visualReview: Retain the existing processing presentation, showing the actual escrowed material and paid progress without inventing inventory stock. Bind started/progress/completed/cancelled events to operation ID, mode, resolved target, paidRounds, finite remainingRounds, charged effort and actual output or release IDs. Replay must show the same material entering escrow, successive paid rounds, and exactly one completion or cancellation. Replace the observed 'NaN remaining' text with validated numeric progress. No completion animation or satisfaction cue may play for cancelled work.
reviews.specification:
Deliver a versioned patch to process-willow through the current implementation handoff, depending on willow-materials@1 and the shared operation/reference dispatcher. Preserve its public schema: {mode:'strip'|'twist',target:string}, required fields only. Use shared item:/object:/resource: reference syntax and ambiguity handling. Resolve and validate a new execution once: twist requires one owned bast; strip requires one owned unprocessed bundle or a visible reachable willow with actual stock. Before resolving an incoming reference against inventory, check whether the action continues the actor's existing operation using its recorded mode, original request reference and canonical target identity. Matching continuation must address that operation's actual escrow, not require the original inventory item to exist. Genuine action changes cancel before resolving a new execution.
Persist operation ID, actor/life identity, mode, original reference, resolved input/source IDs, start position, required access, actual escrow records and ownership, totalRounds, paidRounds, remainingRounds, and terminal settlement status. Derive remainingRounds=max(0,totalRounds-paidRounds); reject nonfinite/inconsistent counters without generating work or material. Twist remains three stationary rounds at one energy each; strip remains four at two energy each. Charge each eligible round exactly once; ordinary metabolism continues. Retain original provenance, mass, moisture and aging in exclusively operation-owned escrow attributed to the actor. No other operation may spend it. On the last paid round, atomically consume escrow and produce precisely the existing recipe outputs once, with actual input lineage. Do not withdraw source stock again on continuation.
Validate life, energy, stationarity and applicable access each round. Standing-source stripping retains visible, unblocked surface reach within 0.65 and excludes trunk overlap; carried inputs track the carrier, not obsolete pickup coordinates. Preserve shared collision geometry and all existing material effects. Movement, changed action, death or another declared invalidation cancels once: release only surviving unconsumed escrow through normal inventory/death disposition, never restore standing stock, duplicate released material or refund effort. Global pauses preserve exact progress without elapsed simulation time.
Migration: preserve valid live pending operations and normalize counters from authoritative recorded paid work; do not reconstruct terminal operations. Lin's cancelled operation remains terminal, its released bast remains unchanged, and any new execution starts at zero paid rounds. Preserve mastery, source balances and event history. The one-round development learning estimate concerns continuation diagnostics; existing masters require no relearning of this unchanged interface. Test full strip/twist completion, original-reference continuation, cancellation/death, repeated settlement, pauses, action changes and legacy counter normalization. Register and retain willow-work-started, willow-work-progress, willow-work-completed, willow-work-cancelled and willow-engagement-qualified; subscription validation must recognize each. No simulation time passes during patch delivery.
